[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=61.0", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "nmbackend"
version = "0.0.1"
description = "NuclearMatter-Backend: differentiable EOS + TOV tools for neutron-star EOS inference, interfacing RIFT and gwkokab."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.9"
license = { file = "LICENSE" }
authors = [
    { name = "R. O'Shaughnessy" },
    { name = "RIT CCRG nuclear-matter group" },
]
keywords = ["neutron-star", "equation-of-state", "TOV", "tidal-deformability",
            "gravitational-waves", "automatic-differentiation", "jax", "RIFT", "gwkokab"]
dependencies = [
    "numpy>=1.21",
    "scipy>=1.7",
    "jax>=0.4.20",
    "jaxlib>=0.4.20",
    "diffrax>=0.5",     # adaptive (accurate) TOV backend; default solver
    "pyyaml>=5.0",      # packaged FRIB scenario-ladder data (lab_likelihood)
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
# Heavier / external reference backends, kept optional so the core stays light.
reprimand = []          # pyreprimand (high-accuracy reference TOV); install separately
rift = []               # RIFT / lalsuite for downstream inference
gwkokab = ["numpyro"]   # population-inference target
test = ["pytest>=7.0"]
docs = ["sphinx", "myst-parser"]

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
nmbackend = ["data/*.yaml", "data/*.dat", "cooling/*.patch", "cooling/*.sh", "cooling/README.md"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
addopts = "-q"
